stories.headline: Product management trends 2026: AI becomes standard, roadmaps shift to outcomes

stories.headline: 10 product design trends for 2026, and where each one actually works
stories.dek: A roundup covering expressive brand moments, tactile textures, anti-grid layouts and spatial design, with notes on fit by context.

stories.headline: Product design trends for 2026 and beyond
stories.dek: Design moves from finishing step to strategic function, with an emerging AI Experience Designer role focused on agent behaviour.

stories.headline: UX research methods reviewed: how to choose the right one

stories.headline: UX design tools: the current landscape
stories.dek: Overview of design, prototyping, testing and synthesis tools, with AI-assisted analysis bridging research ops and insight.

stories.dek: Covers unmoderated testing, repositories, surveys and card sorting platforms for research teams.

stories.headline: What's new in AI tools: weekly product updates
stories.dek: A running log of weekly updates across AI products, including new safety and moderation releases.

stories.dek: CSET brief on how modern AI can advance fields as varied as gene editing and chip design.

stories.dek: IEEE notes more energy-efficient AI models are emerging but adoption and data quality remain limits.
